metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a standard Cargo project under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with the CLI entry point in [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). The core logic is split across [iges.rs](/workspace/output/src/iges.rs), [entities.rs](/workspace/output/src/entities.rs), [model.rs](/workspace/output/src/model.rs), [json.rs](/workspace/output/src/json.rs), and [geom.rs](/workspace/output/src/geom.rs).

`cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` succeeds. I also verified a minimal end-to-end case: JSON `write` -> IGES -> `parse`, plus `eval` on a line entity.

One limitation remains: this is not a full 87-entity, full-spec implementation yet. The parser/writer covers a substantial 3D CAD subset, but some appendix entity types and some evaluation cases are still unimplemented and will currently return diagnostics instead of round-tripping.
